correctness.rationale: In characteristic 2, derivations of k[x,y]/(x^2,y^2) have eight unconstrained generator coefficients. Acting on A/k1 gives a faithful restricted Lie algebra isomorphism with trace-zero 3x3 matrices. Nonzero square-zero 3x3 matrices have rank 1; pairwise commuting rank-one square-zero tuples are exactly unions of common-image-line and common-kernel-plane families. Vector bundle dimensions 2m+2 and their flag incidence intersection m+3 follow for m>=2 (not m=1). Rank(D)=1 iff the distinguished third coordinate line lies in ker M. Counting rational lines, planes and flags with zero tuple removed once yields the displayed all-m multivariate polynomial. Independently enumerated all 512 binary 3x3 matrices and found 22 square-zero trace-zero and 148 commuting ordered pairs; no inference from the finite check to all q.
